mapper.insert: INSERT INTO design_submissions(id, full_name, address, phone, note, file_id, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{id}, #{fullName}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{note}, #{fileId}, 'pending_confirmation', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.full_name, d.address, d.phone, d.note, d.file_id, f.path AS image_url, d.status, d.created_at FROM design_submissions d LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = d.file_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE design_submissions SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
